title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa essentials: an update on investigation of essential genes
strain_evidence: Review. Discusses P. aeruginosa strain PAO1 annotation, MPAO1 (Lee et al.) grown on six media incl. CF sputum, and PA14 (Liberati et al. mariner MAR2xT7).
notes: Background/introduction only. Use to locate primary datasets; do not extract labels from the review itself.

title: Essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in cystic fibrosis sputum
strain_evidence: Uses BOTH strains: 'Wild-type PAO1 and individual transposon mutants with growth defects in SCFM2'; 'only two genes were significantly less fit in SCFM2 than in MOPS-sputum in both PAO1 and PA14'. PAO1 mutant fitness reported directly.
notes: CORRECTION: previously classified PA14-only; direct PAO1 rows and separate PA14 rows are present. Raw supplements are local; condition/phenotype matching remains required.

title: General and condition-specific essential functions of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain_evidence: 'The P. aeruginosa parent strain was MPAO1'; transposon mutagenesis via E. coli SM10 lambda-pir/pIT2 (Manoil-lab two-allele/ISlacZ system). Comparison table lists this study strain as PAO1.
supplementary_available: yes (sd01.xlsx and Supporting Information.pdf present in data/raw/literature/lee2015)
notes: CORRECTION: strain is MPAO1 (PAO1-derived). Lee-original PAxxxx rows join by locus ID with sublineage caveat. D-21 binary labels instead use Varadarajan2020 DS1 unique MPAO1-to-PAO1 best-hit mapping; the reanalysis is not independent replication. Raw supplements are local.

title: Defining the core essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain: nine strains (PA14 + eight isolates; excludes PAO1)
strain_evidence: Table 1 lists BL23; BWH005; BWH013; BWH015; CF77; PS75; PA14; X13273; 19660. PAO1 appears in reference/comparative discussion and was not screened in this study. Verified 2026-11-11: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1900570116
locus_tag_system: per-strain tags; essential lists indexed by PA14_ID and Cluster_ID
supplementary_available: yes (sd01-sd07.xlsx and SI present in data/raw/literature/poulsen2019)
pao1_usable_directly: no (PAO1 not screened; cross-strain mapping required)
pa14_mapping_needed: yes (PA14_ID reference to PAO1; retain study-strain context)
notes: CORRECTION 2026-11-11: earlier inclusion of PAO1 was a reference-context misreading. Tier5 multi-strain/core-essential evidence; no PAO1 identity-join subset. A mapped PAxxxx coordinate does not establish a PAO1 assay. APPROVED_LIMITED Turner 1:1 mapping permits controlled L-03b drafts only; not validation-ready.

title: Identification of fitness determinants during energy-limited growth arrest in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain_evidence: 'We grew cultures of the PA14 wild-type (WT) strain aerobically... in minimal medium with 40 mM pyruvate'; reads 'mapped to the UCBPP-PA14 genome sequence' via ARTIST pipeline.
method: Tn-seq (energy-limited growth arrest; pyruvate-C or O2 limitation)
supplementary_available: yes (sd1-sd4.xlsx and figure TIFFs present in data/raw/literature/basta2017)
notes: Confirmed PA14. Growth-arrest survival differs from growth essentiality. Raw supplements are local. Limited Turner 1:1 orthology approval permits controlled L-03b drafts only; call derivation and phenotype-specific comparison remain required. Erratum 10.1128/mbio.00576-18.

title: Surviving the host: microbial metabolic genes required for growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in physiologically-relevant conditions
strain_evidence: 'we used a saturated transposon insertion mutant pool of P. aeruginosa strain PAO1 and transposon insertion sequencing (Tn-Seq), to identify genes conditionally important for survival'. SCFM among conditions.
notes: CORRECTION: explicitly PAO1. Raw supplements are local. Host-condition fitness requires its own matched medium and phenotype interpretation; local presence is not completed validation. Published 2022-11-25.
